retraction.reason: Retracted in M40b: the rising of October 1956 against the Hungarian government and the Soviet presence, crushed by the Red Army in a fortnight. The atlas holds no record of the eastern bloc's internal history — no Berlin 1953, no Prague 1968 — for it to connect to, and its clearest reach into Portugal, the crisis it caused in the western communist parties and so in the PCP, would need that crisis as a record here. Wiring it forward to 1989 across thirty-three years would be an invention.
